summary: Frontend-only bug-fix verification for PediDrip 'Cetak' (print) button. Verified via Playwright popup capture on mobile viewport (430x900). All acceptance criteria pass: print now opens a dedicated therapy-sheet document in a new window (not the app UI), with the correct heading, the new 'Bolus / muat (sekali beri)' column, correct bolus values (0,05 mg/kg and 0,60 mL), correct 'Laju pump' (0,72 mL/jam), and the 'Kartu titrasi untuk syringe' section. Regressions (read-midazolam=0,72; theme toggle) still work.
critical_code_review_comments: print.js webPrint uses window.open + document.write which is correct for headless/preview; setTimeout(500) before print() is reasonable but on print-blocked contexts (iframe fallback) errors are swallowed silently — acceptable for web print.
printHtml.js buildTherapyHtml properly escapes user input (patient name/RM) via esc(); good XSS hygiene.
colspan=5 in tfoot correctly matches the new 6-column table (5 label cols + 1 rate col).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Print bug-fix verified: With weight=12, expanding Midazolam via 'text=Midazolam' click, opening bolus-toggle-midazolam (default 0,05 mg/kg -> bolus-vol-midazolam=0,60), then summary-toggle-midazolam, then print-btn — a popup opens (about:blank) whose HTML contains: main heading 'PediDrip — Lembar Terapi Infus Kontinu', header 'Bolus / muat (sekali beri)', row values '0,05 mg/kg', '0,60 mL', laju '0,72 mL/jam', and section 'Kartu titrasi untuk syringe'. No JS errors/pageerrors captured. Theme toggle regression OK. Playwright capture used context.expect_page() to grab the popup.
